title: Gadget Gary's New Invention
content: Met with Gary today to discuss his latest invention. We're preparing a patent application for a new type of smartwatch with integrated health monitoring features. Need to ensure all documentation is in order for the provisional filing. Gary is a friend of my husband.

title: GIPE Seminar Notes
content: Attended the GIPE seminar on public patent law. Key takeaways include the importance of clear claims in patent applications and the role of patent agents in the innovation ecosystem. Great refresher on the basics and some networking with peers. Might be interesting to share some insights from this seminar with Mark, a friend of her husband.
